decisions.reason: Confirmed a title overclaim, not a failure of the displayed action definition. With J0=R, U(q)=(q^2-1)^3 and E in (-1/2,1/2), let c be the real cube root of E and a=-sqrt(1+c), b=sqrt(1+c). Since c>-1, a<b; U(a)=U(b)=E, and |q|<b implies q^2-1<c and hence U(q)<E. At E=0, U(q)=(q-1)^3(q+1)^3 has cubic endpoint roots at +/-1 and U'(q)=6q(q^2-1)^2 vanishes there. Removed simple from the title without imposing stronger hypotheses or changing the Definition.
